title: Ultimate 5000 Bar Salt Blackberry Strawberry Blueberry 10ml E-Liquid By Ultimate Juice
description: Dive into berry bliss with Ultimate 5000 Bar Salt's Blackberry Strawberry Blueberry. This exquisite e-liquid is a perfect harmony of nature's finest berries, combining the deep, rich taste of blackberries, the sweet allure of strawberries, and the tart vibrancy of blueberries. This trio of flavours delivers a full-bodied, berry-forward vape experience that's as refreshing as it is satisfying. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between rich flavour and ample cloud production, while the Nicotine Salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod vape devices. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, it caters to both moderate and high nicotine preferences. Nicotine salts’ unique alkaline formulation allows for a higher concentration of nicotine without the harshness, delivering a smoother throat hit compared to high-strength freebase liquids. They are absorbed into the bloodstream faster, providing near-instant relief from nicotine cravings, making Nic salt e-liquids a superior choice for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking immediate satisfaction. Inspired by the intense and super-satisfying flavours of the brand’s bestselling Ultimate Bar disposable vape devices, the Ultimate 5000 Bar Salt range includes a collection of 20 irresistible flavours that span classic favourites as well as exciting new blends, ensuring a premium vaping experience for every palate.
